snippet.title: Too Many Animals! – Official Launch Trailer | Out Now on Steam!
snippet.description:
Imagine being a librarian, but instead of books, you're organizing thousands of adorable animals!

Welcome to **Too Many Animals!**, a cozy first-person sorting game where you identify, collect, and throw cute animals onto their correct shelves.

🐾 Discover hundreds of unique animal species!

🦁 Sort thousands of adorable animals!

🚀 Throw animals across the room and land them directly on shelves!

✨ Unlock powerful upgrades to make sorting faster and more satisfying!

Can you organize them all?

🎮 **OUT NOW ON STEAM!**
https://store.steampowered.com/app/5324570/Too_Many_Animals/

Developed by MrSui Games Studio, a solo indie developer from Malaysia.

**AI Disclosure:** AI was used only to assist with localization. No generative AI was used to create game assets.

#TooManyAnimals #IndieGame #CozyGames #SteamGames #Gaming #indiedev
